tagline: Community-focused bank providing financial services in Massachusetts and New Hampshire
hero_kpi_rationale: The net interest margin of 3.57% represents a key indicator of banking profitability and increased by 29 basis points in 2025, reflecting the effectiveness of asset and liability management in a variable rate environment

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin between interest earned and interest paid
kpis.description: Net Interest Margin is a key indicator of a bank's profitability. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, historical data over the past 5 years.

kpis.name: Loan Growth

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Early position in the 10-K, elevated alert language, significant potential impact on credit conditions and financial results

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental domain for banks, borrower defaults and contractual breaches, significant potential impact on credit losses and profitability

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Primary bank exposure, sensitivity of net interest income to rate changes, direct impact on primary revenue source

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to market volatility, asset price fluctuations, external market conditions impacting portfolio value

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Critical function for banks, dependence on deposits, access to external funding sources, cash flow management

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Continuously evolving regulatory environment for the banking sector, capital and liquidity requirements, government policies

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Business model based on customer relationships, importance of trust, potential impact on deposit base and loan portfolio
